messages:
sajal: Noticing a weird spike in gpu attach latency in eu-central1, ~25% retries in the last 12m. Rooted to a small set of hosts. Anyone seeing fsync storms?

ivy: yes. gn-rcp-44 and gn-rcp-46 showing repeated fsync bursts during snapshot sweep. dmesg shows nvme reset loops and blk_mq timeouts.

harper: paste of dmesg snippet from gn-rcp-44:
```
[40901.123456] nvme nvme0: I/O 12 timed out, aborting
[40901.123789] blk_mq_dispatch: queue 1 stuck, inflight 160
[40901.124000] nvme0n1: nvme_submit_sync: status: 0x88
[40901.124500] nvme nvme0: controller reset due to error
```

nate: looks like snapshot-sweep + overlayfs metadata checkpoint colliding with many parallel attaches. The snapshot job churn does lots of small renames + fsyncs.

ivy: confirmed. janitor kicked off a "snapshot-sweep" job across thousands of ephemeral volumes 11m ago. Concurrency was at 20.

sajal: mitigation proposal: reduce snapshot-sweep concurrency to 2 on eu-central1, pause scheduled checkpointing on affected hosts, and add attach-routing blacklist. Also cordon the worst hosts.

harper: commands I'm running now:
```
# reduce concurrency
kubectl -n ops patch configmap janitor-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/snapshot_concurrency","value":"2"}]'
# cordon one host
kubectl cordon gn-rcp-44
kubectl drain gn-rcp-44 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```

nate: I'll push a routing canary to shift new small attaches to eu-west1 for 45m. deploy-bot will log the change.

deploy-bot: Router policy updated: attach-routing (eu-central1 hotlist) -> eu-west1 (canary, 45m).

ivy: follow-up: schedule SMART quick checks on gn-rcp-44/46. If drives show rising read/uncorrectable errors or >3% reallocated, plan replacements.

sajal: opened INC-4388 to track. Runbook updates: add janitor backoff during snapshot windows, set snapshot_concurrency default to 2 in ops config, and recommend 3% regional hot spares.

harper: PR for runbook change coming. Also we should consider adding a short jitter to snapshot start times per host to avoid coordinated fsync waves.

nate: agreed. cost note from infra: adding 3% hot spare in-region is marginally cheaper than repeated attach retries causing customer errors. I'll add a line item to the quarterly infra cost planning.

sajal: status: cordoned 1/2 hosts, snapshot_concurrency patched, routing fallback live. Attach retry rate dropping. Leaving open for SMART and postmortem.
